steps.name: 끌기 수식키 시험 덱 zsdrag 만들기(글 e01 · 사각형 e02 · 그림 e03)
steps.js: const p=await fetch('/api/deck/zsdrag',{method:'PUT',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({"id": "zsdrag", "title": "끌기 수식키", "slides": [{"id": "s1", "elements": [{"id": "e01", "type": "text", "x": 64, "y": 64, "w": 400, "h": 64, "text": "끌기 Abc", "size": 20}, {"id": "e02", "type": "rect", "x": 64, "y": 200, "w": 320, "h": 96, "fill": "surface-container"}, {"id": "e03", "type": "image", "x": 64, "y": 360, "w": 320, "h": 160, "src": "assets/images/t.png"}]}]})});if(p.status!==200)return 'PUT '+p.status;const ok=await until(async()=>document.querySelector('#deckTabs button[data-deck="zsdrag"]'),15000);return ok?true:'no tab zsdrag · tabs='+[...document.querySelectorAll('#deckTabs button[data-deck]')].map(b=>b.dataset.deck).join(',')

steps.name: Shift 끌기 - 한 축으로만(가로가 크면 세로 0) · 격자 8 에 붙음 · 실행 취소로 제자리

steps.name: 정리 - 시험 덱 zsdrag 저장 끝(떠날 때 확인 안 뜨게)
목록에 없는 덱 id 해시 - 방금 만든 덱이면 목록을 다시 받아 넘어가고, 없는 id 면 '찾을 수 없습니다' 알림을 띄우고 남는다

steps.js: const w=(n)=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,n));const id='zgone'+Date.now()%100000;const p=await fetch('/api/deck/'+id,{method:'PUT',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({title:'지울 덱',slides:[{id:'s01',elements:[]}]})});location.hash='#'+id+'/1';const on=!!(await until(()=>{const b=document.querySelector('#deckTabs button.on');return b&&b.dataset.deck===id&&window.NexaStudioLink.S.id===id;},8000));if(!on)return 'not on '+id+' · PUT '+p.status;await w(300);const of=window.fetch,seen=[];let fake=1,del=0;window.fetch=async(u,o)=>{const s=String(u);if(s.includes('/api/deck/'+id))seen.push(((o&&o.method)||'GET')+' '+s.split('/api/')[1]);const r=await of(u,o);if(fake>0&&s.includes('/api/version/'+id)){fake--;const d=await r.clone().json();d.deck='1';if(Array.isArray(d.deckIds)&&!d.deckIds.includes(id))d.deckIds.push(id);del=(await of('/api/decks',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({action:'delete',id})})).status;return new Response(JSON.stringify(d),{status:200,headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'}});}return r;};const got=!!(await until(()=>seen.some(x=>x.startsWith('GET')&&x.includes('gone=ok')),20000));await w(4500);window.fetch=of;const toasts=[...document.querySelectorAll('.toast, #toast, #notice.show #noticeMsg')].map(e=>e.textContent).join('|');const plain=seen.filter(x=>x.startsWith('GET')&&!x.includes('gone=ok'));return got&&del===200&&fake===0&&!plain.length&&!/다시 불러왔습니다|불러오지 못했습니다/.test(toasts)?true:JSON.stringify({got,seen,plain,del,fake,toasts:toasts.slice(0,200)})
